chapter.verse: Tu-in Antioch khua pawlpi ah kamsangte leh hilhcian syate om uh a, Barnabas, Niger a kici Simeon, Cyrene khuami Lucius, (Ukpi Herod tawh a kineulawmta) Manaen, Saul cihte ahi uh hi.
Amaute Topa bia-in antangin a om laitakun Kha Siangtho in, “Nasem dinga ka sehsa Barnabas leh Saul keima' ading hong khenkhia un,” ci hi.
Amaute in zong antanna leh amau' tungah khutngak thungetna a neih khit uh ciangin sawlkhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amau zong Kha Siangtho' sawlkhiat bangin Seleucia khua ah paisuk uh a, tua tak panin tembaw tawh Cyprus tuikulh ah pai uh hi.
Salamis khua a tun uh ciangin Jew mite' vengkhawm innte ah Pasian' thu pulak uh hi. John pen amaute' nasemhuh ahi hi.
Tuikulh bup ah pai kawikawi-in Paphos khua a tun uh ciangin Bar-Jesus minnei Jew mi kamsang zuau, mitphialsiam khat tawh kituak uh hi.
Pasian' thu za nuamin Barnabas leh Saul a sam, mipil miciim, tualsung mangpa Sergius Paulus' kiangah tua mipa na om hi.
Mitphialsiam Elymas (cih min khiatna a nei tua mipa) in amaute langpangin upna pan tualsung mangpa heikhiat ding sawm hi.
Ahih hangin Paul zong a kici Saul pen Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin tua mipa en gige a,
“Nang, zuauphuahna leh zulhzauna khempeuh tawh a kidim, dawimangpa' tapa, dikna thu khempeuh ii galpa aw, Topa' lampi a tangte kawisak dinga na hanciam, khawl lo ding na hi hiam?

Tu-in en in, Topa' khut nang' tungah om ta hi. Khuamulo na suak ding a, hun kiseh khat sung ni na mu kei ding hi,” ci hi. Thakhat thu-in Bar-Jesus' tungah meiilum leh khuamial hong kia a, amah zong a khut pan lenin a makaih ding mi a zongin kilehleh hi.
Thupiang teng a muh ciangin tualsung mangpa zong a kihilhcian Topa' thu lamdang sa mahmah ahih manin um hi.
Tu-in Paul leh a lawmte Paphos panin tembaw tawh Pamphylia gam Perga khua tung uh hi. Tua ciangin John in amaute nusia-in Jerusalem ah kileh hi.
Himah taleh amau teng Perga pan paisuak uh a, Pisidia gam Antioch khua tung uh hi. Sabbath ni-in vengkhawm inn ah lutin tu uh hi.
Vengkhawm ukte in Thukhun Laibu leh Kamsang Laibu a sim khit uh ciangin amaute' kiangah thu zasak uh a, “Sanggamte aw, mipite hanthotna kam gennop na neih uhleh gen un,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul dingto a, a khut a van khit ciangin hih thu teng gen hi: “Israel mite leh Pasian a kihta mite aw, na ngai un.
Hih Israel mite' Pasian in i pupite na teelin Egypt gam ah pemta-in a om sungun a khut sanglapin tua gam pan na paikhiatpih hi.
Tua ciangin gamgawtak lakah kum sawmli sung amaute na thuak keeikaai hi.
Canaan gam ah minam sagihte a suksiat khit ciangin tuate' gam amaute luahsak hi.
Tu-a ciang pen kum zali-le-sawmnga sawt a, tua khit ciangin kamsang Samuel dong thukhente koih hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in kumpi khat ngen uh a, Pasian in zong Benjamin beh sungpan khat ahi Kish' tapa Saul, kum sawmli sung koih hi.

Tua ciangin Pasian in Saul hemkhia a, ‘Ka lungsim tawh kituak mi, keima' deihna khempeuh a sem ding, Jesse' tapa David ka mu khinzo hi,’ ci-in teci pangin a gen David pen amaute' kumpi dingin koihto hi.
A ciamsa mah bangin Pasian in Israel mite' kiangah tua David ii suanlekhak sungpan Honpa khat, Jesu, puak hi.
Jesu' hong tun ma-in John in Israel mite khempeuh' tungah kisikna vai baptizena thu na ma-tangko khinzo hi.

Tua ciangin John in ama' vaipi a zawh ding ciangin, ‘Kei kua hi-in nong ummawh uh hiam? Kei amah ka hikei hi. Ahih hangin, en un, kei' nungah hong pai khat om a, a khe-a a bulh khedap a suahsak dingin zong ka kilawm kei hi,’ ci hi.
“Sanggamte aw, Abraham' innkuan tuletate leh note' laka om Pasian a kihta mite aw, Pasian in eite' tungah hih hotkhiatna thu hong puak khinzo hi.
Jerusalem khuamite leh a uliante un amah hitaleh, Sabbath nisima kisimkhia kamsangte' thugente hitaleh theitel lo uh ahih manin ama' tungah thukhenna tawh tua thute tangtungsak uh hi.
Ama' tungah sihna a thuaktaak thu mu lo napi-un thahna thu a piak nadingin Pilate konlawh uh hi.
Ama' thu a kigelh teng a vekin a cinsak khit uh ciangin singkhuam tungpan amah domkhiasukin hankhuk sung khat ah sial uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in misite' lakpan amah thokiksak a,
Galilee pan Jerusalem ah amah tawh khualzinkhawmte' tungah ni tampi sung kilang hi. Tuate pen tu-in mite' tungah teci ahi uh hi.
Tua hi a, i pupite' tunga Pasian' ciamsa Lungdamna Thu hong puak ka hi uh hi.

Tua kamciam pen Pasian in Jesu a thawhkiksakna tawh amau' suanlekhak ahi eite' tungah hong tangtungsak hi. Phatna La dawng nihna ah a kigelh mah bang ahi hi: “‘Nang pen keima' Tapa na hi a, tuni-in nangma' pa ka suak hi.’
Tua banah misite' lakpan Jesu a thawhkiksak ciangin pumpi muatna ah kilehkik ngei nawnlo ding ahihna hih bangin na gen khinzo hi: “‘A siangtho, a muanhuai David' tunga kamciamte no kong pia ding hi.’
Tua ahih manin Late dawng dang khat ah zong hih bangin gen hi: “‘Nangma' Mi Siangtho pen pumpi muatna na tuaksak kei ding hi.’
A hang pen David in ama' khan sungin Pasian' deihna a sep khit ciangin ihmu a, a pupite tawh kisialkhawmin pumpi muatna tuak hi.
Himah taleh Pasian' thawhkiksakpa in pumpi muatna tuak lo hi.

Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, hih mipa' tungtawnin note' kiangah mawhmaina thu hong kipulak ahihlam leh Moses' thukhun ii hong suahtaksak zawhloh thute khempeuh pan note hong kisuaktasak ahihlam thei ta un.
A hang pen ama' hangin a umte khempeuh kisuaktasak hi.
Tua ahih manin kidawm un; tua hikeileh Kamsang Laibu sunga kigen a nuai-a thu hong tungkha ding hi:
“‘En un, no mi zahpihte aw, lungmang unla maimang un; A hang pen nomau' khan sungin na khat ka sem a, tua pen note' kiangah hong gen om mah leh zong na up ngeiloh ding uh thu ahi hi.’”
Thugen khit, Paul leh Barnabas a paikhiat ding uh ciangin Sabbath kik ah hih thute hong gen nadingun amaute in kho uh hi.

Vengkhawm kikhop pan a kikhen khit uh ciangin Jew mite leh biakna lutthak Pasian a bia tampitak in Paul leh Barnabas zui uh ahih manin amau zong tua mite hopih uh a, Pasian' hehpihna sungah a omzom nadingun hanthawn uh hi.
Sabbath Ni a tunkik ciangin Topa' thu a ngai dingin khuazang bup phial kikhawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin mihonpi a muh uh ciangin Jew mite biaknavai thangpaihna tawh kidim uh a, Paul' thugente langpanin amah zahpih kobawl uh hi.

Paul leh Barnabas in hangtak thugen uh a, “Kul ahih manin note' tungah Pasian' thu hong gen masa ka hi uh hi. Note in na nolh uh a, tawntung nuntakna tawh kituak lo na hih uh noleno thu kikhen na hih manun, en un, kote Gentile mite' lamah ka kihei ta uh hi.
A hang pen Topa in zong hih bangin kote' tungah thupiak hong nei khinzo hi: “‘Gentile mite' tungah khuavak dingin nang kong koih khinzo a, leitung mongte dong ah hotkhiatna na puak ding hi.’”
Hih thu a zak ciangun Gentile mite lungdam uh a, Topa' thu pahtawi uh a, tawntung nuntakna ngah dinga kiseh peuhpeuh in um uh hi.
Tua hi a, tua gam sung bup ah Topa' thu kizel hi.
Ahih hangin Jew mite in Paul leh Barnabas a bawlsia dingin Pasian a bia numei thupite leh khuasung uliante hansuah uh a, tua ciangin amaute' gam pan hawlkhia uh hi.
Paul leh Barnabas in zong a khe uh-a leivuite amaute' lamah sinkhiatsan uh a, tua panin Iconium khua ah pai uh hi.
Nungzuite pen nuamna leh Kha Siangtho tawh kidim uh hi.
